answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a reputation meadow where identities must wander on trails of work. Each agent keeps a signed nectar ledger: every verified job adds an attested drop, and drops decay when idle or flooded. Drops cannot be forged, since each binds a unique workchain proof to a prior task countersigned by the requester. A Sybil swarm faces a cold start — thousands of fresh accounts hold zero drops, so their consensus weight stays near zero. Longevity becomes the currency: honest agents compound trust over time, while Sybils stay stranded in an empty meadow.
